hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | tr -d "\n"); BLOCKED=""; echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm -rf|git push --force|git reset --hard|DROP TABLE|truncate" && BLOCKED="危险命令被拦截: $CMD"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git commit.*-m"; then MSG=$(echo "$CMD" | sed -n "s/.*git commit.*-m [\x27\"]\([^\x27\"]*\)[\x27\"].*/\1/p"); if [ -n "$MSG" ] && ! echo "$MSG" | grep -qE "^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore)(\(.+\))?: .+"; then BLOCKED="Git 提交信息不符合 Conventional Commits 格式: $MSG\n示例: feat(auth): add login endpoint"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$BLOCKED" ]; then echo "[PreToolUse BLOCK] $BLOCKED" >&2; exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(java)$ ]]; then cd $(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH")/../.. && mvn checkstyle:check spotless:check 2>/dev/null; fi'

bash -c 'if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(vue|ts|tsx|js)$ ]]; then cd $(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH")/../.. && pnpm prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null && pnpm eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi'
bash -c 'CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | tr -d "\n"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "mvn test|vitest"; then echo "[循环反馈] 测试已运行，检查结果是否满足 DoD（覆盖率 ≥ 80%）"; fi'

bash -c 'echo "
========================================"; echo "[质量门禁] 会话结束检查"; echo "========================================"; ROOT=E:/learnspace/harness-agent; PASS=true; echo "
--- Java 编译 ---"; if [ -d $ROOT/backend ]; then cd $ROOT/backend && mvn compile 2>/dev/null && echo "[OK] compile" || { echo "[FAIL] compile"; PASS=false; }; fi; echo "
--- TypeScript 类型检查 ---"; if [ -f $ROOT/frontend/node_modules/.bin/vue-tsc ]; then cd $ROOT/frontend && pnpm vue-tsc --noEmit 2>/dev/null && echo "[OK] vue-tsc" || { echo "[FAIL] vue-tsc"; PASS=false; }; else echo "[SKIP] 前端依赖未安装"; fi; echo "
--- DoD 提醒 ---"; echo "请确认已核对 docs/definition-of-done.md 对应清单"; echo "请确认已更新 docs/task-list.md 任务状态"; echo "请确认已更新 CHANGELOG.md"; echo "
========================================"; $PASS && echo "✓ 质量门禁通过" || echo "✗ 质量门禁未通过，请修复后再提交"; echo "========================================"'
